source: public: Renault/Nissan 1.5 dCi (K9K engine) runs Siemens/Continental SID301/SID305/SID306/SID310 or Delphi DDCR, with newest cars on Continental SID3xx evo. The K9K 1.5 dCi is one of Europe's highest-volume small diesels; mappings are extensively documented.
notes: 1.5 dCi (K9K). Family candidate SET: Siemens/Continental SID30x/31x and Delphi DDCR, split by MY/market; not resolved here. NO part_numbers shipped: Renault ECU numbers (e.g. '2370xxxxxx', '8200xxxxxx') encode Renault part supersession, not the engine. Context-match only. 0x7E0 CAN UDS (early DDCR cars may be K-line).

source: public: Renault 1.9 dCi (F9Q) and 2.0/2.3 dCi (M9R/M9T) run Bosch EDC15C3 (early 1.9), then Bosch EDC16CP33 and EDC17C11/C42. The M9R/M9T 2.0/2.3 dCi is also used in Nissan and Opel/Vauxhall vans. Widely documented.
notes: 1.9/2.0/2.3 dCi (F9Q/M9R/M9T). Candidate ECU set EDC15C3 -> EDC16CP33 -> EDC17 by engine/MY; split not resolved. Early EDC15C3 cars are K-line (no 0x7E0); the address applies to the EDC16/17 CAN cars. NO part_numbers shipped. Context-match only.
